observations: Startup selects embedded English despite --sub-file. The added external file is Track 3; selecting it through the real track menu immediately shows EXTERNAL FPS FIRST.
Accessible progress write 0.2 seeks while paused to coarse 00:00:12. Settled progress is 0.20062988452117111, with green/black marker pattern and EXTERNAL FPS FIRST.
Actual Playback settings > Subtitles editor initially shows 23.976 fps, matching isolated startup configuration.

Windows accessibility set_value on the string editor changes displayed text to 50. After focusing and pressing Enter it reverts to 23.976 fps. The existing dirty/onTextEdited gate ignores that accessibility route.

Ctrl+A selects exactly 23.976 fps in the visible focused editor although the accessibility focused_element incorrectly continues reporting the title. Actual type_text 50 followed by Enter shows 50.000 fps.

With 50.000 fps applied, an additional independent observation still shows EXTERNAL FPS FIRST at held progress 0.20062988452117111 and elapsed 00:00:12. This is an observed paused-retiming failure, not acceptance.

A new accessible progress write of 0.2 shows EXTERNAL FPS MIDDLE. The subsequent settled GUI position is 0.17130192797987034 and elapsed 00:00:10, while the seek OSD initially says 00:12. The request/settled position discrepancy is retained as a failure; no exact frame-conservation claim is made.
Tracks > Subtitle menu > Synchronize exposes one Subtitle frame rate spinner with real value 50. Its visible localized text is 50,000 fps, not 50000 fps.

Accessibility write 29.97 to the synchronization spinner returns native float feedback 29.969999313354492. A focused Up increments it to 30.06999969482422. Reset shows 0,000 fps; the stale EXTERNAL FPS MIDDLE caption remains visible at the unchanged paused position.
